import numpy as np
def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    n = len(local_opt_tour)
    u_idx = np.asarray(local_opt_tour)
    v_idx = np.roll(u_idx, -1)
    edge_n_used *= 0.95
    tour_dists = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_used = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    utilities = tour_dists / (1.0 + tour_used)
    k_penalize = max(1, int(np.ceil(0.10 * n)))
    top_indices = np.argpartition(utilities, -k_penalize)[-k_penalize:]
    for idx in top_indices:
        u, v = u_idx[idx], v_idx[idx]
        edge_n_used[u, v] += 1.0
        edge_n_used[v, u] += 1.0
    updated_tour_used = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    mean_tour_dist = np.mean(tour_dists) + 1e-12
    overlap_ratio = np.mean(updated_tour_used > 1.0)
    stagnation_factor = 1.0 + 1.5 * overlap_ratio
    w_idx = np.roll(u_idx, 1)
    tour_neighbor_dist = 0.5 * (edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx] + edge_distance[u_idx, w_idx]) + 1e-12
    local_density = mean_tour_dist / tour_neighbor_dist
    norm_density = local_density / (np.max(local_density) + 1e-12)
    base_penalty_scale = 0.25 * mean_tour_dist * stagnation_factor
    for idx in top_indices:
        u, v = u_idx[idx], v_idx[idx]
        rel_len = tour_dists[idx] / mean_tour_dist
        density_mod = 0.5 * (norm_density[u] + norm_density[v])
        penalty = base_penalty_scale * (1.0 + 0.5 * rel_len + 0.5 * density_mod) * edge_n_used[u, v]
        updated_edge_distance[u, v] += penalty
        updated_edge_distance[v, u] += penalty
    return updated_edge_distance

    n = len(local_opt_tour)
    u_idx = np.asarray(local_opt_tour)
    v_idx = np.roll(u_idx, -1)
    w_idx = np.roll(u_idx, 1)
    edge_n_used *= 0.95
    tour_dists = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_used = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    utilities = tour_dists / (1.0 + tour_used)
    k_penalize = max(1, int(np.ceil(0.10 * n)))
    top_indices = np.argpartition(utilities, -k_penalize)[-k_penalize:]
    for idx in top_indices:
        u, v = u_idx[idx], v_idx[idx]
        edge_n_used[u, v] += 1.0
        edge_n_used[v, u] += 1.0
    mean_tour_dist = np.mean(tour_dists) + 1e-12
    penalized_nodes = np.unique(np.concatenate((u_idx[top_indices], v_idx[top_indices])))
    sub_usage = edge_n_used[penalized_nodes, :]
    row_sums = np.sum(sub_usage, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-12
    probs = sub_usage / row_sums
    entropy = -np.sum(probs * np.log(probs + 1e-12), axis=1)
    max_entropy = np.log(n) + 1e-12
    node_rigidity = np.zeros(n)
    node_rigidity[penalized_nodes] = np.clip(1.0 - (entropy / max_entropy), 0.0, 1.0)
    updated_tour_used = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    prev_tour_used = edge_n_used[w_idx, u_idx]
    next_v = np.roll(v_idx, -1)
    next_tour_used = edge_n_used[v_idx, next_v]
    chain_persistence = (prev_tour_used + 2.0 * updated_tour_used + next_tour_used) / 4.0
    chain_persistence_norm = chain_persistence / (np.mean(chain_persistence) + 1e-12)
    tour_neighbor_dist = 0.5 * (edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx] + edge_distance[u_idx, w_idx]) + 1e-12
    local_density = mean_tour_dist / tour_neighbor_dist

    base_penalty_scale = 0.25 * mean_tour_dist
    for idx in top_indices:
        u, v = u_idx[idx], v_idx[idx]
        rel_len = tour_dists[idx] / mean_tour_dist
        density_mod = 0.5 * (norm_density[u] + norm_density[v])
        rigidity_mod = 0.5 * (node_rigidity[u] + node_rigidity[v])
        chain_kick = 1.0 + 0.8 * np.tanh(chain_persistence_norm[idx]) + 0.6 * rigidity_mod
        penalty = base_penalty_scale * chain_kick * (1.0 + 0.5 * rel_len + 0.3 * density_mod) * edge_n_used[u, v]
        updated_edge_distance[u, v] += penalty

import numpy as np
def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    n = len(local_opt_tour)
    u_idx = np.asarray(local_opt_tour)
    v_idx = np.roll(u_idx, -1)
    edge_n_used *= 0.96
    tour_dist = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_used = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    avg_tour_dist = np.mean(tour_dist) + 1e-12
    utilities = tour_dist / (1.0 + tour_used)
    k = max(5, int(np.ceil(0.12 * n)))
    top_k_indices = np.argsort(utilities)[-k:]
    selected_u = u_idx[top_k_indices]
    selected_v = v_idx[top_k_indices]
    edge_n_used[selected_u, selected_v] += 1.0
    edge_n_used[selected_v, selected_u] += 1.0
    k_nn = 8
    part_dists = np.partition(edge_distance, k_nn, axis=1)[:, 1:k_nn]
    local_scale = np.mean(part_dists, axis=1) + 1e-12
    rel_density = np.mean(local_scale) / local_scale
    norm_density = rel_density / (np.max(rel_density) + 1e-12)
    node_mean_dist = np.mean(edge_distance, axis=1) + 1e-12
    spatial_centrality = np.mean(node_mean_dist) / node_mean_dist
    norm_spatial_centrality = spatial_centrality / (np.max(spatial_centrality) + 1e-12)
    stagnation_ratio = np.mean(tour_used > 1.0)
    base_lambda = (0.25 + 0.25 * np.tanh(2.0 * stagnation_ratio)) * avg_tour_dist
    sel_u_dens = norm_density[selected_u]
    sel_v_dens = norm_density[selected_v]
    sel_u_cent = norm_spatial_centrality[selected_u]
    sel_v_cent = norm_spatial_centrality[selected_v]
    density_mod = 0.5 * (sel_u_dens + sel_v_dens)
    centrality_mod = 0.5 * (sel_u_cent + sel_v_cent)
    length_mod = tour_dist[top_k_indices] / avg_tour_dist
    modulation = 0.8 + 0.4 * density_mod + 0.3 * centrality_mod + 0.5 * length_mod
    penalties = base_lambda * modulation * (1.0 + 0.2 * edge_n_used[selected_u, selected_v])
    np.add.at(updated_edge_distance, (selected_u, selected_v), penalties)
    np.add.at(updated_edge_distance, (selected_v, selected_u), penalties)
    return updated_edge_distance

    np.add.at(edge_n_used, (selected_u, selected_v), 1.0)
    np.add.at(edge_n_used, (selected_v, selected_u), 1.0)
    tour_usage = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    overlap_ratio = np.mean(tour_usage > 1.0)
    stagnation_factor = 1.0 + 1.2 * overlap_ratio
    mean_tour_dist = np.mean(tour_dist)
    lambda_base = 0.25 * mean_tour_dist * stagnation_factor
    prev_idx = np.roll(u_idx, 1)
    node_incident_usage = edge_n_used[u_idx, prev_idx] + edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    norm_incident_usage = node_incident_usage / (np.max(node_incident_usage) + 1e-12)
    endpoint_mod = 1.0 + 0.35 * (norm_incident_usage[top_k_indices] + np.roll(norm_incident_usage, -1)[top_k_indices])
    penalties = lambda_base * (1.0 + 0.1 * edge_n_used[selected_u, selected_v]) * endpoint_mod
    np.add.at(updated_edge_distance, (selected_u, selected_v), penalties)
    np.add.at(updated_edge_distance, (selected_v, selected_u), penalties)
    return updated_edge_distance
population.idea: Scale-tailored guided local search for TSP-1000 penalizing high-utility tour edges scaled by local density, tour-level stagnation, and incident-edge usage to efficiently break long local-optima cycles without costly full-matrix scans.
